annotations.title: Start an audit of the person's data

description: Proposes how to read a data file for an audit, from its column names (optionally a type and one example value each) and the results the person wants to publish. Returns a proposed spec (the role of each column, each result written as a claim), how claims are written, the catalog of checks and the points the person has to confirm. It receives no rows.

figures.description: The results the person wants to publish, in their words, e.g. 'share of projects per sector'.
